response: The official farm-harvest price of paddy in Cuttack rose from 1,310 Rs/quintal in 2013-14 to 1,750 Rs/quintal in 2018-19, passing 1,410 in 2015-16 and 1,550 in 2017-18. These are not observed market prices: the publication records paddy at the Minimum Support Price, so the series shows what procurement paid rather than what the market found.
